   JOINT MOTION TO FURTHER EXTEND REBUTTAL TESTIMONY DEADLINE

       In accordance with New Mexico Public Regulation Commission (“Commission”) Rule of

Procedure 1.2.2.12 NMAC, Southwestern Public Service Company (“SPS”), New Mexico

Department of Justice (“NMDOJ”), New Mexico Large Customer Group (“NMLCG”), Occidental

Permian Ltd. (“OPL”), Louisiana Energy Services LLC (“LES”), Federal Executive Agencies

(“FEA”), Targa Resources Corp. (“Targa”), Coalition for Clean Affordable Energy (“CCAE”), and

Prosperity Works (“Joint Movants”), move for an Order revising the procedural schedule to further

extend the deadline for all rebuttal testimony from June 9, 2026, to June 16, 2026. Commission

Utility Division Staff (“Staff”) and Walmart Inc. (“Walmart”) do not oppose this Motion, and the

New Mexico Energy, Minerals, and Natural Resources Department (“EMNRD”) takes no position.

In support of this Motion, Joint Movants state as follows:

       1.      On November 20, 2025, SPS filed its Application for Revision of its Retail Rates

under Advice Notice 341 and Other Associated Relief (“Application”), together with twenty-nine

(29) supporting direct testimonies.




Page 1 of 5
        2.      On December 15, 2025, the Co-Hearing Examiners issued a Procedural Order

setting the initial procedural schedule in the case. Among other dates, that order set rebuttal

testimony for April 17, 2026, and scheduled the public hearing to begin on May 26, 2026.

       3.      On March 13, 2026, the Co-Hearing Examiners issued an Order Granting Joint

Motion for a Revised Procedural Schedule. That order extended the rebuttal testimony deadline to

May 29, 2026, vacated the May 26, 2026 hearing date, and reset the evidentiary hearing to begin

on July 7, 2026.

       4.      On May 27, 2026, the Hearing Examiners granted the Joint Movants’ unopposed

motion to extend the rebuttal testimony deadline from May 29, 2026, to June 9, 2026, based on

the fact that the parties have been engaged in settlement negotiations that may negate the need for

rebuttal testimony. The Hearing Examiners also extended the deadlines for testimony-related

motions in limine, motions to strike testimony, and other testimony-related prehearing motions to

June 18, 2026, with responses due June 25, 2026.

       5.      The parties have continued to engage in settlement discussions and are nearing a

potential settlement that may narrow or resolve issues that otherwise would require rebuttal or

cross-rebuttal testimony.

       6.      A brief extension of the rebuttal-testimony deadline would promote efficiency and

conserve the resources of the parties, the Co-Hearing Examiners, and the Commission. If the

parties reach a stipulation, some or all rebuttal testimony may become unnecessary. If the parties

do not reach a stipulation, the requested extension will allow the parties to prepare rebuttal

testimony based on a more complete understanding of the issues that remain genuinely disputed.




Page 2 of 5
        7.        The requested extension is reasonable. A June 16, 2026, deadline would still fall

approximately three weeks before the evidentiary hearing is scheduled to begin on July 7, 2026

and would not disturb the hearing date.

       8.        Joint Movants therefore request that the Co-Hearing Examiners amend the

procedural schedule to set June 16, 2026, as the deadline for filing rebuttal testimony.

       9.        Joint Movants further request that, to the extent necessary, the Co-Hearing

Examiners extend the deadline for testimony-related motions in limine, motions to strike

testimony, and other testimony-related prehearing motions to June 23, 2026, with responses due

June 30, 2026.

       10.       Joint Movants have included a proposed Order Extending Deadlines as Exhibit A

to this Motion, as a convenience for the Co-Hearing Examiners.

                            [Proposed] ORDER EXTENDING DEADLINES

        THIS MATTER comes before the Hearing Examiners upon the Joint Motion to Further

Extend Rebuttal Testimony Deadline (“Joint Motion”) filed on June 5, 2026, by Southwestern

Public Service Company (“SPS”), New Mexico Department of Justice (“NMDOJ”), New Mexico

Large Customer Group (“NMLCG”), Occidental Permian Ltd. (“OPL”), Louisiana Energy Services

LLC (“LES”), Federal Executive Agencies (“FEA”), Targa Resources Corp. (“Targa”), Coalition

for Clean Affordable Energy (“CCAE”), and Prosperity Works (“Joint Movants”). Being duly

informed, the Hearing Examiners FIND and CONCLUDE:

        1.         The Joint Movants request a further extension of the deadline for filing rebuttal

testimony from June 9, 2026, to June 16, 2026. 1

        2.         As grounds, the Joint Motion states that “[t]he parties have continued to engage in

settlement discussions and are nearing a potential settlement that may narrow or resolve issues that

otherwise would require rebuttal or cross-rebuttal testimony.,” and, “[a] brief extension of the

rebuttal-testimony deadline would promote efficiency and conserve the resources of the parties, the



        1
            Joint Motion (June 5, 2026), ¶ 8.
 Co-Hearing Examiners, and the Commission. If the parties reach a stipulation, some or all rebuttal

testimony may become unnecessary.” 2

        3.          The Joint Motion is unopposed. 3

        4.          Having given due consideration to the Joint Motion and circumstances presented,

the Hearing Examiners find good and sufficient cause to extend the rebuttal testimony deadline.

        5.          The Hearing Examiners also recognize the appropriateness of extending the

deadlines for any motions in limine, motions to strike testimony, and other prehearing motions that

may be filed with respect to testimony. The Hearing Examiners’ March 20, 2026, Order Setting

Status Conference and Motion Deadlines previously established that any motions in limine, motions

to strike testimony, and other prehearing motions shall be filed on or before June 12, 2026, and that

responses to such motions shall be filed on or before June 23, 2026.

        6.          The Hearing Examiners’ March 27, 2026, Order Extending Deadlines clarified that

these deadlines applied only for motions with respect to testimony, and extended them to June 18,

2026, and June 25, 2026, respectively.

        7.          The Hearing Examiners now further extend the deadline for testimony-related

motions in limine, motions to strike testimony, and other testimony-related prehearing motions to

June 23, 2026, with responses due June 30, 2026.

IT IS THEREFORE ORDERED

        A.          The Joint Motion is GRANTED.

        B.          The deadline for filing of rebuttal testimony is extended to June 16, 2026.




        2
            Id. ¶¶ 6-7.
        3
            See id. at 1.
        C.      With respect to testimony, any motions in limine, motions to strike testimony, and

other prehearing motions shall be filed on or before June 23, 2026. Responses to such motions

shall be filed on or before June 30, 2026.

ISSUED under the Seal of the Commission at Santa Fe, New Mexico, on June 5, 2026.
